notes.title: バグ修正のアップデートを実施しました
notes.notes:
A bug was found that prevented some ED branches from functioning properly.


The number of residents killed by running over was not reset correctly when selecting "From the Beginning," so this has been fixed and updated so that the variable is reset correctly when selecting "From the Beginning.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused.

Thank you for your continued support of Trolley Problem.

notes.title: "Trolley Problem" is now available!
notes.notes:
"Trolley Problem" is now available!


Today, "Trolley Problem" is finally released!
I hope you can see the best story for you!

notes.title: "Trolley Probrem"　Released at the end of May 2023!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Yunas, the representative developer of "Trolley Problem".
We are pleased to inform you that rough release date of this game have been decided.

・[u]Release Date[/u]
　End of May 2023


The detailed date and time will be announced here as soon as they are decided, so please wait a little longer.

Finally, I would like to express my heartfelt thanks to all of you who have paid attention to this game even before its release.



- Yunas
